ratings.note: Every add shows the toast, but many members will be looking at it in time and the Basket count persists; missing it costs a doubt or a re-tap, recurring each add.
Phone filter users (the date filter is optional) see no change near the field; recoverable by scrolling up; recurs each change but learnable.
Only members who type or autofill +44; one reformat and retry; recurs per attempt in that format.
Screenshot shows both drills as 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...' on the main device; wrong drill is recoverable on the tool page heading, but it recurs on every phone visit.
Done screenshot shows FT-4471 and FT-4472 for one tool; double taps with no busy state are occasional, the duplicate booking confuses the desk and ties up stock.
Only when a held tool's availability is later than the chosen session (3 of 10 tools); outcome is a wasted trip to a few-hours session with the tool absent.
Screen-reader members navigating by landmark; the button is still reachable in reading order, so it is a detour rather than a block.
Every completed reservation shows Basket (1), but the done page states 'Reservation confirmed' with the number prominently; a mixed signal few will act on, so one below s=3.
Keyboard users who open the list are trapped (WCAG 2.1.2) until they discover Enter/Space chooses an option; recurs each visit.
Most calendar days are non-session days and look selectable; first-time members do not know session days; the error surfaces only later in the flow.
Only filter users meet the yyyy/mm/dd native field; format mismatch is a small hesitation, learned once.
Keyboard users above 480 px reach results before the search field; a detour, not a block.
Core change-session journey wipes three typed fields (probes 18/36/51); retyping and possible errors at Confirm; every round trip via Change.
Latest-first visual order slows scanning for the nearest session at desktop; recoverable by reading the dates.
Accidental removal is occasional; recovery means re-finding the tool and re-choosing loan and day.
Every reservation shows sessions reversed; members skimming for 'Saturday' may pick the 24th; caught only if they read the confirm summary.
Most members recognise 'Added to your basket' as unfinished, so occasional; for those who do not, nothing is set aside at the session (failed task); learned after one miss.
Desktop-only empty right half; aesthetic, no task effect.
Both drills truncate to the same visible text on narrow widths; extra navigation and wrong-tool risk on the primary example task, every visit.
Screen-reader users hear 'One week, button'; the preceding heading usually gives context, so a minor ambiguity rather than a block.
Screenshot confirms search after ten cards on phones; with only ten tools, browsing completes the task, so one below s=3.
Dark-mode users (declared common, older members) read the availability date at ~3.1:1; key decision info, not overcome by learning.
Reversed chronology and ragged grid slow scanning at desktop; recoverable by reading dates.
80 px misalignment at wide widths; purely visual.
Grey band under footer on short desktop pages; cosmetic.
Screen-reader filter users miss the hint unless reading linearly; minor.
Every reservation gets an FT- number resembling the membership number; mix-ups resolved by conversation at the desk.
Every add on a phone: toast gone by 2.5 s, header out of view, no onward link; first-timers may not find the next step; once learned it no longer bites.
Evidence shows the fixed bar covering the open listbox at 375 and the chosen day; scrolling recovers.
Transient toast briefly covers a weekday label; cosmetic.
Inconsistent badge shape in dark mode; the text still carries the meaning (contrast covered separately).
Ragged session grid at desktop; dates remain readable, cosmetic.
Date-filter users only; hint wording mismatches behaviour and may hide later-available tools; recoverable by clearing the filter.
Two value-column offsets on tool details; cosmetic.
Same reversed session order seen in every basket; wrong-week pick possible, caught only on confirm summary.
Unmatched queries show all ten tools with no message; misleading but sighted users can see the item is absent.
Search below all cards on phones; ten tools are browsable, so one below s=3.
Identical placeholder on every card gives no recognition help; names still identify tools.
Members omitting FT- get a generic message; the example hints at the fix; recurs until noticed.
Icon-only Filters hides the date filter for core task 3; list is short enough to scan dates on cards.
Nav labels wrap on phones; still readable and tappable.
Every reservation decides the date twice with different words and a possibly contradictory card; recoverable and the session is shown on confirm, so one below s=4.
Only multi-tool members; rule broken silently and one tool refused at the desk, the trip still useful for the others.
Every completed reservation leaves Basket (1); the done page clearly confirms with reference, so re-checkout is unlikely; one below s=3.
Queries in members' own words ('drill with two batteries') show all ten tools and an empty status; screen-reader users hear nothing; misleading each time.
Wrapped nav makes a tall masthead; cosmetic.
Only after an error then removing everything; confusing but 'Find a tool' is available.
Grey band below footer on short desktop pages; cosmetic.
Every phone visit hides search ~2000 px down; browsing ten cards still completes the task, so one below s=3.
Both drills read identically on phones; wrong-tool detour on the primary task, every visit.
Members who pause (declared common) are not told the hold is limited; may lose a one-of-a-kind tool believing it held.
320 px / 400% zoom users (older members, larger text) get horizontal scroll on the main list (WCAG 1.4.10); not overcome by learning.
After the toast fades the page looks unchanged with no onward link; first-timers may re-press or leave; learned once.
No month caption on the calendar; mild uncertainty, worse near month boundaries; status names the month after choosing.
Phone users opening the loan list see options under the fixed bar; scrolling recovers.
Screen-reader users pressing Reserve without a day get a silent failure (3.3.1/4.1.3), hearing only a date.
Same missing month label; mild uncertainty when planning.
Members planning in short bursts often exceed 10 minutes with no notice (WCAG 2.2.1); the flow fails at Continue.
Two label column widths in details; cosmetic.
Tools available later (about 4 of 10) accept earlier days silently; result is a wasted trip for a tool still out.
Screenshot shows 'Something went wrong. Try again.' and retries never succeed after expiry; a dead end in the critical journey for the rest of the session.
Transient toast over a weekday header; cosmetic.
Ragged session-card layout at 1280; cosmetic.
Twice per reservation 1.2-1.5 s with no visible change; invites repeat taps that duplicate the booking on Confirm.
Closed days accepted until the last step; error has no link back, so members redo the flow.
Heading-navigating screen-reader users get a flat outline; minor orientation cost.
Generic brand identity; no effect on task completion.
Orphan full-width session card; cosmetic.
Forced-colours users at narrow widths are rare, but for them session days are indistinguishable and closed days get chosen; not overcome.
Keyboard and magnifier users see focus move against visual order; dates are labelled, so wrong picks are recoverable.
Stock icon plus name as brand; no usability effect.
Badge loses pill in dark mode; text still conveys meaning.
Sessions before the chosen day offered without comment; adds ambiguity, recoverable on confirm.
Identical placeholder tiles on every card; no visual recognition aid between similar tools.
Basket screenshot confirms reversed visual vs DOM order; wrong-week pick or lost focus possible each visit; shown again on confirm.
Keyboard-only users tab through up to 21 days; tedious but passable, every visit.
